openQuestions.q: Should docs/requirements/decisions/authority-runner-session-evidence-envelope.md be added to the story files/plan so the closed-enum runner provider text is updated to match host-neutral declaration behavior?
openQuestions.evidence: The doc currently states supported canonical values are codex, claude-code, and gemini, and that invalid provider values fail closed, while B-6320 intends custom declarations to pass local parsing and leave policy rejection to the server.
openQuestions.resolution: Resolved: yes, docs/requirements/decisions/authority-runner-session-evidence-envelope.md must be updated in B-6320. The old closed enum wording directly contradicts the host-neutral declaration contract and would make later agents reintroduce the local enum failure. This is not scope expansion; it is consistency of logic for the same Authority runner provider declaration behavior.
